title: wt refs swept --json
description: Every run of `wt refs sweep` whose pins are still there, oldest first, read from refs/wt-swept/. Printed by `wt refs swept --json` as the only thing on stdout; it changes nothing. Schema 1: fields may be added and enumerations may gain values; nothing is renamed or removed. See docs/json.md.

repo.description: The main checkout; null outside a repository.

error.description: Why the runs could not be listed.

sweptAt.description: Unix seconds the run began: its meta's sweptAt, else the time in its id. Unix seconds: the meta's, else from the id.

url.description: origin's one effective URL, fetch and push alike, insteadOf and pushInsteadOf applied, with all userinfo removed (git@host:o/r is host:o/r).

digest.description: sha256: and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the effective URL's UTF-8 bytes.

endpoint.description: The origin the run's meta records; null for a local run or a run with no meta. As the meta records it, or null.

id.description: refs/heads/<name> or refs/tags/<name> here; origin:refs/heads/<name> or origin:refs/tags/<name> on origin. --only takes it, one id per flag and never split: a ref name may contain a comma.

kind.description: branch, tag, remoteBranch or remoteTag: a branch or tag here, or on origin.

name.description: The short name of the ref.

pin.description: The pin under refs/wt-swept/ that holds the object.

object.description: The ref's own value: the tag object of an annotated tag, else the tip.

refs.description: Empty for a run that wrote its meta and moved nothing.

runs.description: The runs under refs/wt-swept/, each with its runId, sweptAt, endpoint and refs.
